turn_scope_web_search_fanout.sql:
WITH turns AS (
  SELECT c.request_message_id,
         count(*) AS searches
  FROM agent_tool_call c
  JOIN agent_thread t ON t.id = c.thread_id
  WHERE c.tool_name = 'web_search'
    AND c.started_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-25'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = t.user_id AND u.email LIKE 'golden-runner%')
  GROUP BY c.request_message_id
)
SELECT count(*) AS turns_with_search,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE searches >= 2) AS turns_multi_search,
       coalesce(max(searches), 0) AS max_searches_in_a_turn
FROM turns

round_scope_web_search_fanout_all_histor.sql:
WITH rounds AS (
  SELECT c.request_message_id,
         date_trunc('second', c.started_at) AS dispatch_second,
         count(*) AS searches
  FROM agent_tool_call c
  JOIN agent_thread t ON t.id = c.thread_id
  WHERE c.tool_name = 'web_search'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = t.user_id AND u.email LIKE 'golden-runner%')

       count(*) FILTER (WHERE searches >= 2) AS rounds_multi_search,
       coalesce(max(searches), 0) AS max_searches_in_a_round
FROM rounds

read_depth.sql:
WITH turns AS (
  SELECT c.request_message_id,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.tool_name = 'fetch_url') AS fetches,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.tool_name = 'web_search') AS searches
  FROM agent_tool_call c
  JOIN agent_thread t ON t.id = c.thread_id
  WHERE c.tool_name IN ('fetch_url', 'web_search')
    AND c.started_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-25'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = t.user_id AND u.email LIKE 'golden-runner%')
  GROUP BY c.request_message_id
)
SELECT count(*) AS turns_touching_web,
       sum(fetches) AS fetch_url_calls,
       sum(searches) AS web_search_calls,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE fetches >= 2) AS turns_with_two_or_more_fetches,
       round(avg(fetches), 3) AS mean_fetch_per_turn
FROM turns

latency_ms.sql:
SELECT c.tool_name,
       count(*) AS n,
       round(avg(c.latency_ms)) AS mean_ms,
       percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.latency_ms) AS p50_ms,
       max(c.latency_ms) AS max_ms
FROM agent_tool_call c
JOIN agent_thread t ON t.id = c.thread_id
WHERE c.tool_name IN ('web_search', 'fetch_url')
  AND c.started_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-25'
  AND c.latency_ms IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = t.user_id AND u.email LIKE 'golden-runner%')
GROUP BY c.tool_name

distinct_domains_per_search.sql:
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT c.id,
         c.request_message_id,
         jsonb_array_elements((c.result->>'text')::jsonb -> 'results') AS r
  FROM agent_tool_call c
  JOIN agent_thread t ON t.id = c.thread_id
  WHERE c.tool_name = 'web_search'
    AND c.result ? 'text'
    AND left(ltrim(c.result->>'text'), 1) = '{'
    AND jsonb_typeof((c.result->>'text')::jsonb -> 'results') = 'array'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = t.user_id AND u.email LIKE 'golden-runner%')
), per_call AS (
  SELECT id, count(DISTINCT substring(r->>'url' from '^https?://([^/]+)')) AS domains
  FROM parsed GROUP BY id
)
SELECT count(*) AS calls,
       round(avg(domains), 3) AS mean_domains_per_search,
       percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY domains) AS p50,
       min(domains) AS min, max(domains) AS max
FROM per_call

distinct_domains_per_turn.sql:
WITH parsed AS (

         jsonb_array_elements((c.result->>'text')::jsonb -> 'results') AS r
  FROM agent_tool_call c
  JOIN agent_thread t ON t.id = c.thread_id
  WHERE c.tool_name = 'web_search'
    AND c.started_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-25'
    AND c.result ? 'text'
    AND left(ltrim(c.result->>'text'), 1) = '{'

cost_per_web_turn_micro_usd.sql:
WITH web_turns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.request_message_id
  FROM agent_tool_call c
  JOIN agent_thread t ON t.id = c.thread_id
  WHERE c.tool_name IN ('web_search', 'fetch_url')
    AND c.started_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-08-25'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = t.user_id AND u.email LIKE 'golden-runner%')
), per_turn AS (
  SELECT lcu.owner_id,
         sum(coalesce(lcu.actual_micro_usd, lcu.reserved_micro_usd)) AS micro_usd,
         sum(lcu.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
         sum(lcu.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
         count(*) AS llm_calls
  FROM llm_call_usage lcu
  JOIN web_turns w ON w.request_message_id::text = lcu.owner_id
  WHERE lcu.owner_type = 'turn_request_message'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = lcu.user_id AND u.email LIKE 'golden-runner%')
  GROUP BY lcu.owner_id
)
SELECT count(*) AS turns,
       round(avg(micro_usd)) AS mean_micro_usd,
       percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY micro_usd) AS p50_micro_usd,
       max(micro_usd) AS max_micro_usd,
       round(avg(input_tokens)) AS mean_input_tokens,
       round(avg(output_tokens)) AS mean_output_tokens,
       round(avg(llm_calls), 2) AS mean_llm_calls
FROM per_turn

  WHERE lcu.owner_type = 'turn_request_message'

)
SELECT count(*) AS turns,

       percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY micro_usd) AS p50_micro_usd,
       max(micro_usd) AS max_micro_usd
FROM per_turn

top_domains_returned.sql:
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT jsonb_array_elements((c.result->>'text')::jsonb -> 'results') AS r
  FROM agent_tool_call c
  JOIN agent_thread t ON t.id = c.thread_id
  WHERE c.tool_name = 'web_search'
    AND c.result ? 'text'
    AND left(ltrim(c.result->>'text'), 1) = '{'
    AND jsonb_typeof((c.result->>'text')::jsonb -> 'results') = 'array'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = t.user_id AND u.email LIKE 'golden-runner%')
)
SELECT substring(r->>'url' from '^https?://([^/]+)') AS domain, count(*) AS hits
FROM parsed
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 15

scope: Organic chat-lane traffic only. This is CONTEXT for phase 08, not the comparison sample: phase 08 compares against the phase 02 golden artifact, which is a different population (web-first corpus) and a different unit.

uncited_external_number.reason: cited-ness undefined until phase 02 fixes the observable definition; needs the answer text plus the Turn's display_results set. Not a persistence gap - the results array does survive in agent_tool_call.result->>'text' (77/81 rows parse).

notes: Every metric carries its own n. Read no metric without it.

A round has no column of its own. turn_scope_* groups by request_message_id and so counts a whole Turn (up to MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS = 4 rounds); round_scope_* buckets by the dispatch second, which is the closest observable proxy for one asyncio.gather batch. The two disagree sharply - 21/43 turns versus 8/70 rounds - so quote the unit whenever quoting the rate.
Cost is summed over every LLM call of a Turn (mean 3.6 calls), not per call. A single call measured 20,514 micro-USD; the Turn it belonged to cost more.
actual_micro_usd is used where reconciled, reserved_micro_usd otherwise.
